Bombay High Court Cancels Bail for Corporator Accused of Assaulting Doctors

The Bombay High Court has cancelled the bail granted to a Shiv Sena corporator accused of assaulting doctors in Dombivli. The court ordered the corporator to surrender, noting that the magistrate had taken the case lightly. The assault involved the corporator and others attacking three doctors at a corporation hospital. The Maharashtra Indian Medical Association had suspended a planned strike following the High Court's decision.
